requirements.detail: Imago consumes the Aegis product input manifest and returns image digest, signature reference and boot-evidence fields; malformed manifests are rejected with a correlated error and retries are bounded.

source_refs.quote: The M18 schemas are proposed to cordanaLLM/imago and cordanaLLM/nucleus; acceptance is recorded only when each producer consumes the payload, not a fixed symbol list

requirements.detail: Application defects and legacy HISS infractions surfaced by the governance gates are fixed once lefthook and make verify-all run green.

source_refs.quote: Application defects surfaced by the governance gates are fixed after lefthook and `make verify-all` run green.

requirements.detail: Go code composes golusoris core capabilities (clikit, log, clock, mcp) instead of duplicating them, and declares its remaining demand against the framework capability contract.

source_refs.quote: Every Go repository in the fleet is meant to deduplicate onto golusoris
Downstream governance (cordanallm/praetor: needs scan | report | migrate) resolves .needs.yaml demands against this file

requirements.detail: The repository is addressable as cordanaLLM/imago, the reusable image builder the Aegis-OS connected stack contract names.

source_refs.quote: Reusable image construction, kernel consumption, image artifact production

requirements.detail: Kernel artifacts are consumed from cordanaLLM/nucleus (today lusoris/lusoris-kernel-forge) through a pinned kernel requirement and artifact contract.

source_refs.quote: Kernel configuration, patch selection, kernel artifact production

requirements.detail: An os-image praetor archetype describes OS image forges; until praetor ships it the repository declares the interim gitops-infra profile.

source_refs.quote: Praetor governance is adopted now with the interim profile `gitops-infra`; an `os-image` archetype is drafted here and proposed upstream, and the manifest switches to it once praetor ships it.

requirements.detail: The repository is praetor-governed: declarative .standards.yaml, HISS-16 harness compiled from one AGENTS.md, lefthook gates, a .needs.yaml demand declaration, and participation in fleet demand sweeps.

source_refs.quote: Praetor serves as the universal governance engine and repository-as-code standard for the Cordana ecosystem.
Requires downstream repositories to define `.needs.yaml` and participate in periodic fleet demand sweeps.

requirements.detail: Migration work is tracked as a typed dependency graph compiled by praetor and routed by unblock value per cost, with the ready set available to the CLI and to agents over MCP.

source_refs.quote: Cross-repository contract pin: one local request/result pair
The migration is tracked as a typed dependency graph under `planning/`, compiled with praetor's planning compiler and routed by `imago plan route`.

milestones.title: Identity and module path
milestones.outcome: The Go module, CLI, MCP server, documentation, tests and CI refer to cordanaLLM/imago and the imago binary.

positive: go build ./... and go test ./... pass under the module path github.com/cordanaLLM/imago.
negative: No production file references the lusoris-forge binary or the old module path.
boundary: Historical CHANGELOG entries keep the old names verbatim.

milestones.title: Golusoris core composition
milestones.outcome: The CLI, logger, clock and MCP transport are provided by golusoris core and the remaining demand is declared in .needs.yaml.

positive: praetorctl needs report shows every third-party dependency covered or declared as a retained non-goal.
negative: No production Go file imports the raw MCP SDK, tint, or calls time.Now().
boundary: Tests may import the SDK to drive in-memory transports.

milestones.title: Routed planning graph
milestones.outcome: planning/ holds the compiled praetor draft, the routing overlay, and imago plan route returns the ranked ready set.

positive: praetorctl planning prepare recompiles plan.json to the committed digest.
negative: A dependency cycle or an overlay that omits a step fails imago plan validate.
boundary: A plan at the 512-step limit routes; one step over is rejected.

milestones.title: Praetor governance adopted
milestones.outcome: The repository carries .standards.yaml, .standards.lock, a recorded HISS baseline, compiled vendor context, lefthook gates and make verify-all.

positive: praetorctl audit and compile-context --verify pass on a fresh checkout.
negative: A hand edit to CLAUDE.md fails the pre-commit gate.
boundary: The recorded baseline never grows; touched legacy files must be clean.

milestones.title: Application hardening after gates
milestones.outcome: Legacy HISS infractions and defects surfaced by the gates are fixed and the baseline ratchets to zero.

positive: praetorctl audit reports zero baseline infractions.
negative: A new infraction fails the gate instead of being baselined.
boundary: Functions at exactly 60 lines pass; 61 fail.

milestones.title: os-image archetype upstream
milestones.outcome: praetor ships an os-image archetype and this repository declares it instead of gitops-infra.

positive: praetorctl adopt --profile os-image resolves the pinned catalog without overrides.
negative: gitops-infra-only linters (kubeconform, tflint) are no longer declared.
boundary: The complexity bound stays at 60 lines per function.

milestones.title: Repository transferred to cordanaLLM/imago
milestones.outcome: github.com/cordanaLLM/imago resolves, mirrors and release automation point at it, and the fleet topology lists it.

positive: git ls-remote --heads https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago.git returns main.
negative: release-please and Renovate do not open PRs against the old identity.
boundary: Old links redirect; none are rewritten in historical records.

milestones.title: Aegis product-input contract pinned
milestones.outcome: One local request/result pair against the Aegis M18 schema is retained with positive, negative and boundary results.

positive: An accepted aegis.p01.product-input.v1 request returns image digest, signature reference and boot-evidence fields.
negative: A malformed manifest is rejected with a correlated error.
boundary: A retry at the declared bound is recorded; one above is refused.

milestones.title: Nucleus kernel contract
milestones.outcome: Kernel artifacts from lusoris-kernel-forge (future cordanaLLM/nucleus) are consumed through a pinned requirement and artifact digest contract.

positive: A pinned kernel artifact digest is verified before an image build consumes it.
negative: An unsatisfiable kernel feature requirement is rejected with a correlated error.
boundary: An empty requirement list is rejected explicitly.

steps.title: Rename the Go module and CLI to imago
steps.detail: Move the module path to github.com/cordanaLLM/imago and the command to cmd/imago; rename the binary in Makefile, CI, .gitignore and Python tests.
actions: Rewrite import paths across cmd and pkg.
Rename build targets, workflow steps and test binary paths.

expected_outputs.description: go.mod, cmd/imago and every import compile under the new path.

positive: go build ./... succeeds.
negative: grep finds no github.com/lusoris/lusoris-cloud-images import.
boundary: The Go version directive follows golusoris core (1.27.1).

steps.title: Rename the CLI in documentation and governance text
steps.detail: Update the CLI reference, principles, standards, maintainers and README diagram to the imago name and identity.
actions: Replace lusoris-forge in docs/tools/cli-mcp.md and related pages.
Add the target identity notice to README.md and docs/index.md.

expected_outputs.description: Documentation names imago and cordanaLLM/imago consistently.

positive: pytest tests/test_docs.py passes.
negative: No user-facing page instructs running lusoris-forge.
boundary: CHANGELOG history entries are untouched.

steps.title: Compose the CLI with clikit and core/log
steps.detail: Build the root command with golusoris clikit and replace the tint handler with core/log.
actions: Replace the cobra root with clikit.New and clikit.Command.
Set the default slog logger from core/log.New.

expected_outputs.description: cmd/imago/main.go imports clikit and core/log and no longer imports tint.

positive: imago --help lists every command.
negative: tint is not a direct import of any production file.
boundary: Command help text is unchanged for existing commands.

steps.title: Inject core/clock into the builder and staging guard
steps.detail: Thread an injected clock through builder.Request and the two-phase Stager so time is testable and time.Now is not called in production code.
actions: Add a Clock field to builder.Request and reject requests without one.
Construct the Stager with a clock and drive TTL tests with a fake clock.

expected_outputs.description: No time.Now() call remains outside tests.

positive: Builder and staging tests pass with clock.NewFake().
negative: Dispatch without a clock returns an error.
boundary: Advancing the fake clock exactly past the TTL prunes the staged action.

steps.title: Run the MCP server on core/mcp
steps.detail: Register imago tools on the golusoris core/mcp server through fx and delete the duplicated stdout-purity guard and transport runner.
actions: Expose RegisterTools(server, deps) and wire it with fx.Invoke under coremcp.Module.
Remove pkg/mcp/stdout.go and RunStdio; add the http transport flag.

expected_outputs.description: pkg/mcp imports only core/mcp in production code; tests drive in-memory transports.

positive: The protocol test lists 14 tools and executes them over an in-memory transport.
negative: RegisterTools with a nil stager or clock returns an error.
boundary: Client disconnect on stdio ends the process through fx.Shutdowner.

steps.title: Declare framework demand in .needs.yaml
steps.detail: Generate .needs.yaml with praetorctl needs scan against the golusoris capability contract and declare testify as a retained non-goal.
actions: Run praetorctl needs scan --write on the migrated module.
Record the testify retention note referencing praetor issue #34.

expected_outputs.description: .needs.yaml lists every third-party dependency with its capability and replacement.

positive: praetorctl needs report shows 100% mapping availability.
negative: A dependency without a capability key fails the scan.
boundary: Standard-library slog stays excluded from third-party counts.

steps.title: Author and compile the planning graph
steps.detail: Write planning/plan.json as a praetor schema-1 draft citing the fleet sources, compile it with praetorctl planning prepare, and commit the projections.
actions: Cite each source by SHA-256 and quote it verbatim.
Compile into a new directory and copy plan.json, TODO.md, ROADMAP.md and MILESTONES.md back.

expected_outputs.description: planning/ holds the canonical draft and three cross-linked projections with one digest.

positive: A second compile produces the same digest.
negative: An unknown requirement reference is rejected by the compiler.
boundary: Every step names between 1 and 32 requirements.

steps.title: Route the graph from the CLI and MCP
steps.detail: Implement pkg/planning with DAG validation, a routing overlay, and ranking by (1 + transitive unblocks) / cost; expose imago plan route and the route_plan MCP tool.
actions: Load and validate plan.json and routing.json with bounded reads.
Rank ready local work first and expose the result through CLI and MCP.

expected_outputs.description: imago plan route prints the ranked table; route_plan returns the same JSON.

positive: The ready set is ordered by score with deterministic tie breaks.
negative: A cycle, an unknown cost or a missing overlay entry fails validation.
boundary: A plan over 512 KiB is rejected before decoding.

steps.title: Reconcile cadence epics with the graph
steps.detail: Keep .github/epics.json for recurring cadence work and document how one-off graph steps relate to epics and milestones.
actions: Review each epic for overlap with graph steps.
Record the division of authority in docs/tools/planning-graph.md.

expected_outputs.description: Epics and the graph have documented, non-overlapping authority.

positive: imago lint validates epics.json and imago plan validate validates the graph.
negative: No epic duplicates a graph step.
boundary: Milestones referenced by PR metadata remain valid.

steps.title: Report the praetor Windows path-separator defect
steps.detail: File the adopt failure (catalog artifact path compared against a slash-separated constant in internal/config/catalog_projection.go) upstream with the reproduction.
actions: Open the issue in cordanallm/praetor with the failing command and the one-line fix.
Link the issue from this plan's routing evidence.

expected_outputs.description: An upstream issue tracks the defect.

positive: praetorctl adopt --dry-run succeeds on Windows after the upstream fix.
negative: The defect is not patched by a local fork.
boundary: Both the profiles and facets directories are compared with slash normalisation.

steps.title: Select the Python test gate explicitly
steps.detail: Move pytest configuration to pytest.ini so praetor's project verification identifies the runnable Python gate.
actions: Create pytest.ini with the former pyproject options.
Remove the duplicate section from pyproject.toml.

expected_outputs.description: pytest.ini is the single pytest configuration.

positive: pytest tests/ passes with the moved configuration.
negative: praetorctl adopt no longer warns that project verification is unavailable.
boundary: Strict marker enforcement is preserved.

steps.title: Apply praetor adoption with the interim profile
steps.detail: Run praetorctl adopt with profile gitops-infra and facets security:high, agent:sandboxed, docs:seo-portal; set the repository identity to cordanaLLM/imago; record the HISS baseline.
actions: Apply the adoption from a reviewed praetor source bundle and review every reconciled file.
Merge the harness into AGENTS.md and compile the vendor context.

expected_outputs.description: .standards.yaml, .standards.lock, .standards-baseline.json, lefthook.yml and compiled vendor context are committed.

positive: praetorctl audit passes against the recorded baseline.
negative: compile-context --verify fails on a hand-edited CLAUDE.md.
boundary: The baseline records exactly the infractions the dry run reported.

steps.title: Prove the lefthook and verify-all gates
steps.detail: Install lefthook on a Linux workstation or the generated devcontainer and run the pre-commit and pre-push jobs plus make verify-all on a clean checkout.
actions: Run lefthook install and lefthook run pre-commit.
Run make verify-all and retain the output as evidence.

expected_outputs.description: Retained gate output showing every job executed and passed.

positive: All lefthook jobs and make verify-all exit 0.
negative: A --no-verify commit is blocked by the anti-evasion hook.
boundary: A docs-only change skips the heavy suites through the diff-aware filter.

steps.title: Fix defects surfaced by the gates and ratchet the baseline
steps.detail: Resolve the recorded HISS-02, HISS-04 and HISS-07 infractions and any application defects the lefthook gates or verify-all surface.
actions: Refactor each baselined function below the complexity bound and wrap unchecked errors.
Re-record the baseline only downward.

expected_outputs.description: The baseline reaches zero recorded infractions.

positive: praetorctl audit reports zero infractions.
negative: A touched legacy file with a remaining infraction fails the gate.
boundary: A function at exactly 60 lines passes.

steps.title: Draft the os-image archetype
steps.detail: Write planning/archetypes/os-image.yaml following praetor's archetype authoring guide with the image-forge linters and the 60-line complexity bound.
actions: Define id, runtime, complexity, supply chain, linters and devcontainer features.
Document why gitops-infra is the interim profile.

expected_outputs.description: A complete archetype YAML ready for an upstream pull request.

positive: The YAML parses with praetor's profile schema.
negative: No container-image-only linter is declared.
boundary: max_func_loc is exactly 60.

steps.title: Propose the os-image archetype upstream
steps.detail: Open the praetor issue and pull request adding .config/archetypes/os-image.yaml and a flavor detection rule for Packer and mkosi repositories.
actions: File the archetype request with the drafted YAML and the flavor misdetection evidence.
Submit the pull request once praetor maintainers accept the request.

expected_outputs.description: An upstream issue and pull request exist for the archetype.

positive: praetor main contains .config/archetypes/os-image.yaml.
negative: A Packer repository is no longer detected as python-ml.
boundary: The archetype passes praetor's own catalog tests.

steps.title: Switch the manifest to os-image
steps.detail: Once praetor ships the archetype, change .standards.yaml from gitops-infra to os-image, regenerate the lock and baseline, and drop unused linter declarations.
actions: Run praetorctl adopt --profile os-image with the updated source bundle.
Re-record the baseline and verify the gates.

expected_outputs.description: .standards.yaml declares os-image with a matching lock.

positive: praetorctl audit passes under os-image.
negative: The lock rejects a profile that is not in the pinned catalog.
boundary: Baseline count does not increase across the switch.

steps.title: Create cordanaLLM/imago and enrol it in the fleet
steps.detail: Transfer or mirror the repository to cordanaLLM/imago, then list it under the os-image archetype in the operational fork's .config/fleet-topology.yaml.
actions: Transfer the GitHub repository to the cordanaLLM organisation as imago.
Add the repository to the fleet topology in lusoris/praetor and run praetorctl harvest.

expected_outputs.description: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago resolves and the fleet topology lists it.

positive: git ls-remote --heads returns main for the new identity.
negative: The old identity is a redirect, not a second live repository.
boundary: Branch rulesets from .github/rulesets apply on the transferred repository.

steps.title: Repoint automation and links after transfer
steps.detail: Update remotes, badges, release-please configuration, documentation portal URL, Renovate and the kernel-forge dispatch target to the new identity.
actions: Replace lusoris/lusoris-cloud-images URLs in badges, mkdocs site_url and workflows.
Update the lusoris-kernel-forge repository_dispatch target.

expected_outputs.description: Automation and links reference cordanaLLM/imago directly.

positive: release-please opens its next PR against cordanaLLM/imago.
negative: No workflow dispatches to the old identity.
boundary: Historical CHANGELOG links are left as redirects.

steps.title: Accept the Aegis product-input schema
steps.detail: Implement acceptance of aegis.p01.product-input.v1 (distribution snapshot, repart, sysupdate and mkosi definitions, correlation id, exact revision, bounded retries) as an imago build request.
actions: Add a typed decoder for the manifest with strict unknown-field rejection.
Map the manifest to a build request and return a correlated error for malformed input.

expected_outputs.description: imago validates the Aegis manifest and reports correlated errors.

positive: The Aegis build/product-input.json fixture is accepted.
negative: A manifest without a correlation id is rejected.
boundary: A retry count at the bound is accepted; one above is refused.

steps.title: Retain one local request/result pair with Aegis
steps.detail: Execute the Aegis M09 request/result pair against pinned local checkouts and retain positive, negative and boundary results with image digest, signature reference and boot-evidence fields.
actions: Run the pair with the Aegis fixtures and record the correlation ids and revisions.
Hand the result schema back to Aegis for its M09 evidence.

expected_outputs.description: Retained request/result evidence referenced by both repositories.

positive: The result carries digest, signature reference and boot-evidence fields.
negative: Simulated output is refused as a result.
boundary: An empty requirement list is rejected explicitly.

steps.title: Pin the kernel artifact contract with nucleus
steps.detail: Replace the repository_dispatch kernel sync with a pinned contract: kernel version, config digest, artifact digest and provenance verified before an image build consumes the artifact.
actions: Define the kernel artifact manifest imago consumes and verify its digest and provenance.
Consume the Aegis kernel-requirement payload shape rather than a fixed symbol list.

expected_outputs.description: Kernel artifacts enter image builds only through the verified manifest.

positive: A pinned artifact with a valid digest is consumed.
negative: A tampered artifact digest is rejected.
boundary: An empty kernel requirement list is rejected explicitly.
